title: Pay yourself first
text: Set an automatic transfer to savings for the day after payday. What you never see, you never spend.

title: Find one forgotten subscription
text: Scan last month's card statement for recurring charges and cancel one you would not sign up for again today.

title: Know your FIRE number
text: Multiply your yearly spending by 25. That is roughly the invested amount that could fund your lifestyle.

title: Start a one-month buffer
text: One month of essential costs in a separate account stops small emergencies turning into debt.

title: Ask for a lower rate
text: Call your credit card issuer and ask for a lower APR. A short, polite call can save real money.

title: Check your fees
text: A 1% yearly fee can eat a large share of long-term returns. Look up the expense ratio of every fund you own.

title: Track net worth monthly
text: One number, once a month. The trend tells you more than any budget category.

title: Review your life cover
text: If someone depends on your income, check whether your life insurance would still cover them today.

title: Fixed wake-up time
text: Wake at the same time every day this week, weekends included. It is the strongest lever for better sleep.

title: Walk after one meal
text: A 10–15 minute walk after a meal helps digestion and blood sugar, and adds up to hours each month.

title: Protein at breakfast
text: A protein-rich breakfast keeps you fuller and makes the rest of the day's eating easier.

title: Caffeine curfew
text: Try no caffeine after early afternoon for a week and notice how you sleep.

title: Two strength sessions
text: Twice a week, do squats, push-ups and rows. Muscle is protection for your future self.

title: Morning daylight
text: Get outside within an hour of waking, even for five minutes. Light helps set your body clock.

title: Write your wins
text: Every Friday, write down one result you delivered. Next review, you will have a list ready.

title: Know your market rate
text: Look at five job ads for your role and note the pay ranges. Knowledge is negotiation power.

title: Three hours a week
text: Give one income-raising skill three focused hours a week for 90 days.

title: Reconnect with one contact
text: Message a former colleague today. Most opportunities come through people, not job boards.

title: Fix one daily annoyance
text: The squeaky door, the messy drawer, the broken light. Fix one thing that bugs you every day.

title: Check the 28% line
text: Is your housing cost under about 28% of gross income? If not, plan your next move or renegotiation.

title: Ten-minute reset
text: Set a timer for ten minutes each evening and reset one room. A calm home is a calm mind.

title: Phone-free dinner
text: Put phones in another room for one meal today. Full attention is the best gift.

title: Send the message
text: Text someone you have been meaning to reach out to. Two lines is enough.

title: Ask a better question
text: Instead of 'How was your day?' try 'What was the best part of your day?'

title: Plan a money date
text: Couples: pick a night this month to talk about shared goals, not just bills.

title: Physiological sigh
text: Two quick inhales through the nose, one long exhale through the mouth. Repeat three times when stressed.

title: Brain dump
text: Write every open task and worry on paper. Circle the one thing you can do today.

title: Count your weeks
text: Seeing your life in weeks makes priorities obvious.

title: One goal, one week
text: Pick one goal and define the single action you will take this week. Put it in your calendar.

title: Score your life
text: Rate six areas of your life in two minutes and find your biggest lever.
